package.name: relativistic-simulator
package.summary: 1D special-relativistic constant-force massive-particle dynamics simulator: a ground-truth physics engine for machine-learning research.

eras.label: Iteration 1 — default-range dataset
eras.test_generation: Custom rng(2026) loop calling simulate(..., method='analytic') per row; mass=10^U(0,6), force=±10^U(0,10), beta mixture 70% U(0,0.8) / 20% U(0.8,0.95) / 10% U(0.95,0.999999), time=10^U(-4,5)
eras.note: Training beta is capped at 0.8; the evaluation set reaches beta=0.999999, so this is a genuine extrapolation test.

eras.label: Iteration 2 — physics_data.npy (current)
eras.generation_method: Custom rng(2026) loop calling simulate(..., method='analytic') per row (bypasses generate_dataset() to control the beta mixture directly)
eras.note: The extreme_test_10k file is the SAME file as era 1, but because training now also spans beta up to 0.999999, this set is no longer a true extrapolation test for era-2 models — it is an independently re-drawn sample from an overlapping distribution.
